items.text: He attended high school in Wichita, Kansas
Conner studied at Wichita University (now Wichita State University) and later at University of Nebraska, where he graduated in 1956 with a bachelor of fine arts degree
In 1955, Conner studied for six months at Brooklyn Museum Art School on a scholarship
